evidence.claim: lc keeps header identity, share and summary under different mount conditions. pc is omitted when Xi is truthy; share requires a conversation and false un/Xi; fc requires a conversation and false archive-preview/Xi. These predicates do not by themselves establish a product-mode exclusion.

evidence.claim: lc background-agent callback requires a parent conversation: canInteract=false delegates Xo with parent, selected id and display name; otherwise Yo receives the background-agent object and host. The no-argument overview callback delegates Xo with only parent and host. These callback bodies do not return or await the delegated Promises.
evidence.method: frozen-source complete AST nodes, Program binding and exact ESM/dynamic entry review; no target evaluation

evidence.method: frozen-source complete AST nodes, Program binding and exact ESM/dynamic entry review; no target evaluation
